user.title: Powerbill Forecast
user.description: Turn your energy meter into a live bill with tier tracking and a month-end forecast.

data_description.source_entity: A utility meter that resets every billing cycle, or a total meter that only counts up.
data_description.reset_day: The day your utility reads the meter. PEA/MEA print it on the bill.
data_description.tiers: Only for 'Custom tariff'. Format: 150=3.2484, 400=4.2218, *=4.4217 (upper kWh = price, * = everything above). One flat price: just the price.
data_description.service_fee: Leave empty to use the value of the tariff.
data_description.vat: Leave empty to use the value of the tariff.
data_description.currency: Leave empty to use the tariff or Home Assistant currency.
data_description.ft_value: Only for the source 'Fixed value'. Also used as fallback until the first Ft download. Can be negative.
data_description.ft_source: Official PEA website: fetched twice a day, the same Ft applies to PEA and MEA. Entity: any sensor with the Ft per kWh. Fixed: the value below (0 if your utility has no surcharge).
